name: Darkness in the Glade
label: Quest
description: Darkness in the Glade is an investigation led by Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak into tainted leather belts collected from harpies in the Oracle Glade.…
intro: Darkness in the Glade is an investigation led by Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak into tainted leather belts collected from harpies in the Oracle Glade. Recovering amulets from the harpy matriarchs confirms that demonic fel moss corruption has taken root in Teldrassil's boughs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: These belts... Look closely at the leather, friend. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?
I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.
Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.
I have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.
I will inform my superiors of this at once.
